_comment: Coordinate signature registry (P5 WP1). For each proof check: which criterion params are COORDINATES into the data model's geometry (which legal unit space they address, and how the dimension is selected), plus directional-parameter sign conventions. This is normative pack data: Gate-1 lint, criteria x config cross-lint, solver preconditions, and proposer knowledge prompts all derive from this file. A check added without a signature entry is a pack-validation warning; a signature naming an unknown check is an error. P11: required_blocks lists the config blocks a check needs (dotted entries are sub-key features); blocked/pinned mark paths the engine cannot move.

quarters.description: fiscal quarter labels from the configured calendar

territories.description: territory keys mapping to member regions; present only when accounts.territories is configured

quota_units.description: plan-unit values of the quota block for the criterion's dimension (by_segment / by_territory / by_motion)

capacity_units.description: plan-unit values of the capacity block

tiers.description: product tier labels; present only when products block is configured

coordinates.notes: list of baseline regions the premium is measured against
'_all_' addresses the plan-weighted mean over every unit of the dimension
selects which quota sub-block (by_segment/by_territory/by_motion) defines the unit space

revenue_vs_plan.pinned_quantity: raking pins realized revenue to attainment x plan exactly

directional_params.target_decline_pct: SIGNED: positive value demands a DECLINE of that pct; negative value demands GROWTH of that magnitude (e.g. -12 means '+12% growth'). Tolerance is tolerance_pp.

directional_params.target_change_pct: SIGNED: demanded Q1->Q4 change of average won deal size; negative = decline.

directional_params.min_increase_pp: minimum required RISE in low-ICP creation share, first quarter vs last.

directional_params.target_change_pct: SIGNED: demanded change in blended margin percentage points, first quarter vs last.

directional_params.from_share_pct: entry revenue share in the FIRST quarter
directional_params.to_share_pct: tier revenue share in the LAST quarter

coordinates.notes: names the grouping dimension itself (segment|territory), not a unit - no unit lookup
absent = whole-dimension claim (all plan units); when present it MUST name an existing plan unit of the dimension

SUBSET expression (P6 P2.7): {'top_pct': N} restricts to the top N% of plan units by market potential, {'bottom_pct': N} the bottom N%. Use this for 'the largest/smallest territories' - do NOT invent pseudo-units.
selects which quota sub-block (by_segment/by_territory/by_motion) defines the unit space

quota_vs_potential.pinned_quantity: plan levels are plan-of-record; market potential is generated data - ATTAINMENT KNOBS CANNOT MOVE THIS RATIO (blocked path)

coordinates.notes: absent = every plan-unit row (worst row decides); when present it MUST name a capacity plan unit - narrative words ('headline', 'effective') are not units
grouping dimension name (segment|territory), not a unit

directional_params.target_pct: commit as pct of actual: >100 means commit ABOVE actual i.e. a MISS; <100 means commit below actual i.e. a BEAT.

directional_params.min_headline_growth_pct: lower bound on TOTAL revenue growth
directional_params.max_core_growth_pct: upper bound on EX-OUTLIER (core) revenue growth; core may decline while headline grows only if whales add revenue

directional_params.min_gap_pp: minimum discount-response DIFFERENTIAL between high- and low-potential cohorts (high-potential wr change minus low-potential); driven by pricing_response.elasticity/potential_mitigation
